author: EnderTrevor
body:
My minecraft username, the most recent: EnderTrevor

I was Temp-banned for excessive rudeness for 10 hours and 4 minutes due to swearing excessively at another user.

I do believe it should be taken off my infractions list and I will serve the punishment. I want this because I think I was caught in that because I just got angry because I have had some family "Issue's" in the past week. So I think it was just my stress and anger get the better of me as I tried to do my best not to be this way. I hope the person who can read this understands.

                                                                      Have a great day,
                                                                      Trevor
